title: Terrorism Suspect in Cornellà, Spain, Allegedly Used AI Editing Tools to Produce Jihadist Propaganda
summary: Spanish authorities alleged that a suspect arrested in Cornellà, near Barcelona, used AI-supported editing applications to produce jihadist multimedia propaganda. He allegedly distributed material through social media and encrypted messaging to radicalize others and promote terrorist violence. A court ordered pretrial detention. The reports do not identify the applications or establish that his activity led to an attack.
